# QCrypton PQ Readiness

Post-quantum cryptography posture across scanned Azure resources. Data source: `PQReadiness_CL`.

content.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by QuantumPosture
| render piechart
content.title: Posture distribution

content.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| summarize Vulnerable = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), AssetKind
| render timechart
content.title: Vulnerable findings over time by asset kind

content.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| summarize Latest = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AssetIdentifier
| project Resource = ResourceName, AssetKind, Algorithm, KeySize, Reason = PostureReason, Risk = RiskScore, Expires = ExpiresOn, Subscription = SubscriptionId
| order by Risk desc
content.title: Top vulnerable assets (ordered by risk)

content.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AssetKind in ('tls-cert', 'kv-cert') and isnotnull(ExpiresOn)
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| project ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, SignatureAlgorithm, ExpiresOn, RiskScore
| order by ExpiresOn asc
content.title: Vulnerable certificates by expiry
